title: Pipes: built in, pure, impure and your own

videos.script:
The planner shows dates as computers write them, and every duration as a number of minutes. This lesson writes both the way a person would, with pipes.

{{builtin}} A pipe turns a value into what a template shows. The date pipe writes the week's range, and the rest of Angular's box is a table away.

{{locale}} The first result is American, because the default locale is. One setting makes it British, and nothing in the template changes.

{{own}} Then a pipe of your own, for durations in words, tested with nothing but new and a call. A test from lesson ten fails on the way, and it is right to.

{{pure}} A pure pipe runs again only for a new value. Push onto an array, and the page contradicts itself.

{{impure}} An impure pipe runs on every check, even after a click that changed nothing.

{{choose}} And you sort a pipe from a computed from a method.
